messages.subject: Adding dimension names to table
parts:
I am trying to figure out how to add dimension names to the table. For example, using the table function I can get the following:

LikesCats = c("Yes","No","Yes","No","Yes","No")
LikesDogs = c("Yes","Yes","Yes","No","Yes","No")
table(LikesCats,LikesDogs,dnn=c("Cat Person","Dog Person"))


          Dog Person
Cat Person No Yes
       No   2   1
       Yes  0   3

I cannot figure out how to get dimension names ("Cat Person" and "Dog Person" in this example) shown when using Shiny (xtable),. Any suggestions?
